stem:
The lengths, in millimetres, of a random sample of 12 rods made by a certain machine are as follows.

$$200 \qquad 201 \qquad 198 \qquad 202 \qquad 200 \qquad 199 \qquad 199 \qquad 201 \qquad 197 \qquad 202 \qquad 200 \qquad 199$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find unbiased estimates of the population mean and variance.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Give a statistical reason why these estimates may not be reliable.
